Fix Before Upload: Use lowercase hyphenated handles and keep variants grouped

What To Look For: Blank SKUs duplicate SKUs or supplier placeholders

What To Look For: Private image links broken URLs or non-image pages

What To Look For: Values outside Shopify accepted policy terms

Why It Matters: Variants must map consistently across option columns

Why It Matters: Blocked rows should not be imported until fixed
What To Look For: Rows with required field or format problems
Fix Before Upload: Fix source CSV and rerun a pre-flight check

Why It Matters: Only ready rows should be exported for upload
